title: json+json_3gpp: Pass the same offset and length in compact form or not
description:
Rather than the special decoding functions used by JSON 3GPP (and
possibly other dissectors) having to look at a "use compact" boolean
to see if quotes were removed from strings, pass the offset and
length consistently in the different cases. Then we can remove
the "use_compact" parameter from the decoding functions.

Add some clarifying comments.

The hf_ids registered are always FT_STRING, so use ENC_ASCII instead
of ENC_NA. (Should this be ENC_UTF_8 for JSON? Should escaped
characters be unescaped?)
